sources: https://ohgreenecountyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/splash.html?ccode=SecondaryCamping (Greene County's WebTrac booking site; rental search 'full hookup' for 1 night on 10/31/2026 and 05/18/2027, read in a browser 2026-10-30)

values.note: All 12 full-hookup sites $45 a night on the county's booking site (10/31/2026 and 05/18/2027 nights).

hookups.source: WebTrac site descriptions ('Class A full-hookup, pull-through site includes water, sewer, 30- and 50-amp electric with 110 outlet'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 12 full-hookup pull-through sites (2025 map: an angled pad row beside the shower house); 27 more sites (power/water, primitive and group) are planned. One camping unit and up to two vehicles per site; no more than six people.

sites.source: https://www.gcparkstrails.com/parks/caesar-ford-park/campground/ ('With 12 full-hookup camping sites', 'Future plans include 27 more sites (power/water, primitive, and group)') + WebTrac site descriptions ('pull-through site') + /campground/policies/ (camping equipment, occupancy), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Shower house for campers only, campground picnic shelter and playground.

facilities.source: https://www.gcparkstrails.com/parks/caesar-ford-park/campground/ ('picnic shelter, shower house, and new playground') + /campground/policies/ ('Showers are available for campers' use only'; 'Dump Station'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: April 15 to the first Monday in November.

season.source: https://www.gcparkstrails.com/parks/caesar-ford-park/campground/policies/ ('Campground season is from April 15 to the first Monday in November annually'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Booked per site online on Greene County's WebTrac site (May 2027 nights already open) or at 937-562-6440. Occupancy is no more than 14 days in a 30-day time frame, then campers must leave for 48 hours. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon. Cancellation refunds scale from 2/3 (61-90 days out) to none (3-30 days).

booking.source: https://www.gcparkstrails.com/parks/caesar-ford-park/campground/policies/ ('For reservations visit gcparkstrails.com or call 937-562-6440', 'Occupancy is no more than 14 days in a 30-day time frame', check-in/out, refunds) + WebTrac rental search (sites bookable for 05/18/2027), read 2026-10-30

note: Greene County Parks & Trails, opened 2024. Horses are allowed at sites 1-12 (tie lines behind sites 8-12, trailhead behind site 12) but it is a general RV campground beside the Xenia-Jamestown Connector bike path. --Claude
summary: Priced at $45/night (all 12 sites, county WebTrac engine, 2026 and 2027 nights); confirmed 50-amp full hookups, 12 pull-throughs, showers, dump; added season (Apr 15-first Monday in Nov), WebTrac booking link and 14-in-30-day limit. Note trimmed of facts the fields now hold. Max rig length not stated.
flags: Pin ~400 m off: stored 39.6696,-83.8338 sits west of the campground near Stringtown Rd; the county's 2025 campground map and satellite put the 12 angled pull-through pads beside the shower house at about 39.67060,-83.82935 (the county's own 'GPS: 39.670990, -83.827576' is near the bike path/east side). Suggest 39.6706,-83.8294.
Construction: 'Phase 2 of the Caesar Ford Campground is set to begin mid-May and run through November' (county page, 2026) - the existing 12 sites still book; not a closure.
